text:
zoe: Hit a streaming bug: after a client reconnect the assembled text has chunks out of order and sometimes no final `event: done`.
carter: Which SDK + client? Any raw capture?
zoe: inference-go v0.5.1 and a mobile client. Raw (trimmed):
```
data: {"seq":7,"part":"foo"}

data: {"seq":8,"part":"bar"}

<disconnect>
/data: {"seq":8,"part":"bar"}
data: {"seq":9,"part":"baz"}
```
Note stray leading `/` and dup seq=8 on reconnect.
li: Sounds like partial writes + proxy coalescing. Parity issue: go/pysdk buffer differently than js.
carter: Quick plan: 1) server emit `id:` per SSE event and periodic `:ping`; 2) SDKs adopt small state machine parser that buffers until blank-line and dedup by id; 3) use X-Stream-Session + Last-Event-ID resume.
sdk-bot: Created SDK-902 (parser state machine) and INF-1302 (server id/ping).
ops-bot: stream-health(us-west): elevated reconnects last 30m.
zoe: I'll add a minimal repro in examples/sse-repro-go and a unit that closes TCP mid-event.
carter: Great. Add metric for missing `event: done` and log last-event-id on reconnect.
